halve.subject: a single faceted crystal split cleanly in two by a vertical bronze blade, the two halves drifting apart

tower-of-hanoi.subject: three bronze pegs on a plinth, a stack of four crystal disks shrinking upward on the left peg, one disk in mid-air moving right

fast-power.subject: a faceted crystal inside a bronze frame inside a larger bronze frame inside a larger one, each frame twice the last, glowing hotter outward

karatsuba.subject: two faceted crystals crossed like an X inside a bronze square split into four quadrants, three quadrants lit and one dark

max-subarray.subject: a row of faceted crystals with a bronze bracket spanning a stretch of them across the middle, that stretch glowing amber

counting-inversions.subject: two faceted crystals in a row with small gold arrows crossing over each other between them, the pair glowing where the arrows cross

closest-pair.subject: two nearly identical cyan faceted crystals drawn together by a bronze caliper, a spark between them

skyline.subject: a small city skyline of faceted crystal towers of different heights on a bronze base, the outline traced by one gold line

median-of-medians.subject: five small bronze trays of five crystals each, the middle crystal of each lifted up, and the middle of those lifted highest and glowing

introsort.subject: a bronze split arrow, one branch a quick lightning zig-zag and the other a neat tree, both ending in the same sorted row of faceted crystals
